search_text: published ZDI-23-1599 ZDI-CAN-21806 Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView Backup Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-11-14 CVE-2023-30912 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-30912 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['OneView'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the Backup functionality. The issue results from the product's use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView Backup Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the Backup functionality. The issue results from the product's use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
